title: Shin et al. 2017 (Experiment A) — Open Access Dataset for EEG+NIRS Single-Trial Classification
description: An open access dataset for hybrid brain-computer interface research combining EEG and near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS). This portion (Experiment A) contains recordings from 29 healthy participants performing left versus right hand kinesthetic motor imagery over multiple sessions. The data include EOG and motion-artifact recordings and are provided preprocessed, with baseline CSP and shrinkage LDA classification results for validation.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz from 30 active electrodes with a BrainAmp amplifier (linked-mastoid reference, Fz ground), together with EOG. NIRS was recorded at 12.5 Hz with a NIRScout. Each session had 20 trials with 10 s kinesthetic motor imagery of hand opening and closing at 1 Hz after a visual arrow cue, separated by 15-17 s rest periods. Data were preprocessed (common average reference, 0.5-50 Hz bandpass, ICA-based EOG rejection, downsampled to 200 Hz) and classified using CSP, log-variance features and shrinkage LDA with 10x5-fold cross-validation.
